name: @crafter/li-metrics
description: Read-only LinkedIn post analytics CLI for authenticated browser sessions
author: Crafter Station

scripts.test:repeat: bun test && bun test && bun test
scripts.check: biome check src tests package.json tsconfig.json biome.json README.md
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check && bun test
scripts.native:build: mkdir -p dist && scriptc build src/native-cli.ts --no-keep-c -o dist/li-metrics
scripts.native:smoke: dist/li-metrics --json schema post.metrics > /tmp/li-metrics-native-schema.json && bun src/cli.ts --json schema post.metrics > /tmp/li-metrics-bun-schema.json && cmp /tmp/li-metrics-native-schema.json /tmp/li-metrics-bun-schema.json
scripts.release:check: bun run verify && bun pm pack --dry-run
